prompt: What is the difference between bundle_id, bundle_version, and policy_revision in a Kei policy bundle? When does each one change? Do not execute anything — just explain in text. If you don't know something, just say so.
assertions: explains bundle_id is UUIDv7 unique per issuance
explains bundle_version is per-installation monotonic counter bumped on every issuance
explains policy_revision is workspace-wide bumped only on policy changes
mentions the catalog's 6-hour reuse window and re-issue at half-life
